# sequentialist-core

> Reusable engineering for checkpointed, auditable applications of sequential statistics.

## Understand the library

- [Development roadmap](ROADMAP.md) / [План развития](ROADMAP.ru.md): audited gaps, priorities, dependencies and completion criteria across the ecosystem.

- [Ecosystem catalog](docs/ecosystem-catalog.md) / [Каталог экосистемы](docs/ecosystem-catalog.ru.md): package selection and current status.
- [Unified technical specification](docs/ecosystem-spec.md): architecture, acceptance cases and delivery stages.
- [AI discovery](docs/ai-discovery.md) / [Документация для AI](docs/ai-discovery.ru.md): coding context, retrieval and publication boundaries.
- [Plain-language overview](docs/overview.md): use cases, inputs, outputs, limitations and FAQ.
- [Обзор на русском](docs/overview.ru.md): применение, входы и выходы, ограничения и частые вопросы.
- [README](README.md): Handler example, supported modules and engineering guarantees.
- [Package manifest](pyproject.toml): dependency and Python-version requirements.

## Inspect implementation

- [Engine](src/sequentialist/core/engine.py): record intake, tasks and recovery.
- [Storage](src/sequentialist/core/storage): supported backends and locking.
- [Audit](src/sequentialist/core/audit.py): decision lineage and verification.
- [Reports](src/sequentialist/core/report.py): findings with explicit guarantees.
- [Tests](tests): executable behavioral evidence.
